purpose: This table holds one row per scheduled flight departing from the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) between 2013-01-01 and 2013-06-30, combining schedule, actual timing, delay, cancellation, aircraft, and origin/destination airport reference attributes for 166158 flights.
usage: Read the table at the grain of one row per flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, and origin_airport combination. Use the scheduled and actual time fields together with the delay fields to analyze on-time performance, join aircraft attributes for fleet analysis, and use the origin/destination reference columns for geographic context; expect nulls in actual-time, delay, and reference fields for cancelled flights or unmatched reference rows.
limitations: The profile confirms only whole-row uniqueness (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), not uniqueness of the proposed grain tuple itself; this must be checked by deterministic grain measurement. Aircraft reference fields (manufacturer, model, year, seat_count, engine_type) and destination reference fields (name, municipality, iso_region, elevation, runway length) carry null rates from roughly 2% to 17.7%, reflecting incomplete reference joins rather than data quality defects in the flight records themselves. The captured_at column's values and semantics suggest pipeline ingestion metadata despite not being flagged is_airbyte_metadata; a reviewer should confirm its intended meaning. dest_delay fields' true negative bound (early arrivals/departures) is taken on faith from sample values and was not independently verified beyond the observed min/max.
